name: enterprise-conduct
description: Enterprise work-ethic skills: audience/trust-boundary and blast-radius judgment for real production codebases.

plugins.name: trust-boundaries
plugins.description: Keep internal information out of public SDKs, docs, changelogs, and error messages, and secrets out of the repo.

plugins.name: professional-output
plugins.description: Make commits, docs, and prose read like a professional's — no AI self-attribution, badges, or slop.

plugins.name: calibrated-judgment
plugins.description: Match effort and caution to blast radius: confirm destructive/production actions, avoid accidental breaking changes.

plugins.name: enterprise-conduct
plugins.description: Umbrella: the two instincts (audience, blast radius) plus a pre-flight checklist; routes to the three pillar skills.
